🌟 dioramas | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Building interactive, visually stunning 3D landing pages and websites with AI-generated assets.
✨ Key Features: • AI-generated 3D assets (Nano Banana 2 + Meshy 7.1) • Optimized 3D models for web (meshopt, WebP) • three.js based engine with advanced post-processing effects • Scroll-based choreography and interactions • Includes 20 complete example websites
📖 Summary: Dioramas is an open-source framework for creating cinematic, interactive 3D websites. It leverages AI to generate 3D assets from text prompts, which are then optimized and integrated into a three.js engine for visually rich, scroll-driven experiences.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ Liquid-glass-studio | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a user-friendly, visual tool for designers and developers to easily create and export CSS code for the iOS 26 liquid glass effect without requiring any build tools or dependencies.
✨ Key Features: • Visual design of iOS 26 liquid glass effect • One-click CSS and Tailwind CSS code generation
📖 Summary: Liquid Glass Studio is a zero-dependency, vanilla JavaScript web application that allows users to visually design and generate CSS or Tailwind CSS code for the iOS 26 liquid glass effect. It provides a live preview with fine-tuned controls and the ability to use custom backgrounds, making it easy to replicate complex frosted glass designs.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
